client_completion_probe.method: Verify the artifact SHA-256. In a fresh Node VM, evaluate the artifact from const MAXIMUM_CONCURRENT_UPLOADS onward, replacing export class StorageClient with class StorageClient and exposing that class. Supply WebCrypto, TextEncoder, Uint8Array, Blob and URLSearchParams. Stub resolveBlobContentType to application/octet-stream and formatBlobContentDisposition to undefined. Replace getCertificate with Uint8Array([1]); no agent runs. Stub fetch with ok:true and json returning the case's status, recording method/path; unexpected retries fail. Call putFile with UTF-8 abc and record progress. Repeat in a fresh VM for each case.
client_completion_probe.substitutes: All HTTP responses, certificate bytes and MIME/disposition helpers. fixture_not_complete is an invented negative control, not an observed gateway status. No real certificate validation or provider call.
client_completion_probe.conclusion: The pinned client's returned hash and 100% progress do not require a blob_complete response. Even a positive flag still needs authoritative provider completion semantics.

funding_result_probe.encode_command: didc encode '(variant { Err = variant { TopUpWithoutCycles } })' --types '(AccountTopUpResult)' --defs docs/evidence/caffeine-cashier.did
funding_result_probe.method: Pipe the same encoded hex into each decoder; both succeed. The reply is synthesized, not obtained from an actual top-up.
funding_result_probe.source_observation: Storage.refillCashier declares an empty account_top_up_v1 result, then reports success=true and topped_up_amount=cyclesToSend after the await. It does not inspect structured Cashier errors or an accepted-cycle amount.
funding_result_probe.conclusion: Wire compatibility does not make the wrapper's reported success or amount a validated provider outcome. Retain typed results and separately reconcile accepted/refunded amounts.

callback_identity_review.authority_observed: Caller membership in the integration's authorized gateway principals.
callback_identity_review.conclusion: A root-only callback cannot by itself distinguish an old deletion from a newer object using the same root. A local incarnation must not be filled from whichever object is current. Provider namespace exclusivity, root non-reuse or stronger authoritative correlation must be qualified before binding callbacks.

cashier_recovery_review.direct_top_up: AccountTopUpRequest contains only optional account and target_balance; AccountTopUpResponse contains balance and text message. No typed caller operation ID or operation receipt is advertised by these types.
cashier_recovery_review.audit: AuditLogDownloadResponse returns csv_content plus pagination. Candid does not specify the CSV columns, exact top-up correlation, completeness or retention.
cashier_recovery_review.ledger_alternative: NotifyCyclesLedgerDepositResponse includes ledger_block_index and credited, but the request contains only optional account. LedgerDeposit/TopUp audit event names and a block index do not prove an exactly-once sweep/credit contract after a lost response. This route remains a research candidate, not selected funding behavior.
cashier_recovery_review.conclusion: No automatic retry after an uncertain payment can be justified from these signatures or balance differences alone. Server semantics and evidence retention remain required.

limitations: Source inspection, public GitHub/npm reads and isolated substitute/codec experiments only. No update call, payment, account lookup, gateway upload/deletion or PocketIC journey. This does not qualify Caffeine, freeze the service contract or establish that missing guarantees are impossible.
